scope: Static, read-only application investigation; new report/scripts only; not production acceptance

original_file_integrity.digest_algorithm: SHA256 of sorted tracked path + NUL + SHA256(file bytes) + newline, excluding newly added experiment paths
original_file_integrity.coverage: Includes application, specs/contracts, ontology, ETL, mappings, fixtures, all frozen implementation/evaluation and pilot artifacts

checks.check: Attempt output overwrite, parse all experiment JSON, verify case/script/source hashes against retained results
checks.result: passed; overwrite refused with exit 2 and existing output bytes unchanged

focused_tests: Existing mocked in-process TestClient /ask checks, not live service/provider/data requests
verification_rationale: All original tracked files byte-identical; scoped admission/capability tests and deterministic experiment replay are the smallest credible checks for isolated report/scripts additions.
